== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[I Want Every Part Of This Ship Checked (Errata)]] (Virtual Block 7.1), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text; the other versions of the card are [[I Want Every Part Of This Ship Checked]] (original).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive), unchanged in every capture to 11 January 2013. The card list writes icons out; icons are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table. Once per game, if Obi-Wan on table, may deploy Vader from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May place this Effect in Used Pile to take a [Grabber] into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If you just attempted to take a card into hand or deploy a card from Reserve Deck, and the card was not found, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to search your Force Pile for that card instead.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1007_L6372</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>1_266</code>, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 7 set mark) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
